service.name: SceneResource_StreamVdpRecord
algorithm: Returns immediately when SCENE_SCRIPT_PENDING is 0x02 or the active stream pointer is null.
Reads SCENE_RESOURCE_VDP_STREAM_OFFSET, adds 0x0E, and wraps it to zero when it reaches SCENE_RESOURCE_VDP_STREAM_END.
Loads one long VDP command address followed by five VDP command words from the selected 14-byte record.
Acquires the Z80 bus, writes the record through VDP_CONTROL while preserving the command address in VDP_COMMAND_ADDRESS_LATCH, waits for the VDP FIFO, and releases the bus handoff.

stream_contract.producer: Level_LoadFromSceneState at 0x001AA58E/0x001AA596 copies the level-table stream pointer and end offset.

conclusion: The anonymous helper is a scene-resource VDP command-record streamer. Its rotating offset, fixed 14-byte record shape, Z80 handoff, and FIFO synchronization are now separate from the broad level-transition coordinator.
